references.label: Center horseshoe
references.description: Tight loop that raises Bonus X, lights the kicker, and advances title letters.

references.label: Horseshoe rollovers
references.description: Two switches inside the horseshoe; a complete trip can award two title letters.

references.label: Center-bottom kicker
references.description: Kickout that scores 5,000 and can collect the configured Special.

references.label: Center N target
references.description: Target lit for Extra Ball or points after a horseshoe beyond 5x.

references.label: Side spinners
references.description: One alternately lights for 1,000 per spin after completing the title.
